passionate-void-offering.name: Passionate Void Offering
passionate-void-offering.description: Give unto The Void a generous 100,000 credits.

peppered-bait.name: Peppered Bait
peppered-bait.description:
This bait attracts fish that are active in the Plains of Eidolon during the day.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Attracts Mawfish and Charc Eels in the lake; Khut-Khut, Yogwun, and Mortus Lungfish in ponds; and Goopolla and Tralok in the ocean.

peram-fishing-spear.name: Peram Fishing Spear
peram-fishing-spear.description:
This fishing spear has multiple blades that allow it to pierce the hides of scaly fish. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Glappid
Khut-Khut
Mawfish
Mortus Lungfish
Norg

pharoma.name: Pharoma
pharoma.description:
A compound that relaxes nearby fish.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).

phase-specter.name: Phase Specter
phase-specter.description: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.

phase-specter-regiment.name: Phase Specter Regiment
phase-specter-regiment.description: An army composed of phase-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for two conflicts.

pherliac-pods.name: Pherliac Pods
pherliac-pods.description: Creates 50x Pherliac Pods that releases powerful pheromones to attract the Infested.

pistol-ammo-box.name: Pistol Ammo Box
pistol-ammo-box.description: Restores a bunch of pistol ammo.

pobbers-echo-lure.name: Pobbers Echo-Lure
pobbers-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Pobbers with life-like animal calls. The Pobbers is most often found around the Mushroom Fields of Orb Vallis.

pobbers-pheromone-synthesizer.name: Pobbers Pheromone Synthesizer
pobbers-pheromone-synthesizer.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Pobbers.

potent-pherliac-pods.name: Potent Pherliac Pods
potent-pherliac-pods.description: Creates 50x Potent Pherliac Pods that releases powerful pheromones to attract the Infested.

predasite-echo-lure.name: Predasite Echo-Lure
predasite-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Predasite with life-like animal calls.

predasite-pheromone-gland.name: Predasite Pheromone Gland
predasite-pheromone-gland.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Predasite.

processed-fass-residue.name: Processed Fass Residue
processed-fass-residue.description:
Matter from the body of the Wyrm Fass, purged of toxins, and rendered usefully. Used to attract Aquapulmo and Flagellocanth in Cambion Drift surface hotspots, Aquapulmo only during Vome.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).

processed-vome-residue.name: Processed Vome Residue
processed-vome-residue.description:
The flesh of Vome, refined, and ready for use. Used to attract Myxostomata in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Vome.

Obtained from Daughter in the Necralisk (Deimos).
